spec: research/math-momentum-structures-v1.md (Math-inspired uphill momentum structures v1.1, reevaluated 2026-10-08)
status: SHADOW RESEARCH ONLY. Never read by Captain v3.1.1. Never places orders. Results never affect official v3 entries or sizing.
frozen_at: first run; any change requires math-momentum-v1.0.1+

timestamp_safety.cutoff_rule: most recently completed 15-minute block (America/Toronto) at run time
timestamp_safety.knowledge_rule: received_ts <= cutoff + knowledge_grace_s (a bar that closes exactly at the cutoff is physically received a few seconds later; grace = v3.1.1 data_gates.expected_bar_grace_s)
timestamp_safety.labels_rule: training/calibration labels must resolve at or before the cutoff; embargo between train end and each test fold >= horizon
timestamp_safety.no_backfill: a cutoff already recorded in shadow.db is never re-run; missed blocks are not run retroactively

features.orientation: Directional features are bullish-positive as is. volRatio and ATRrank are not directional: inside the Uphill score they are signed by the current move (volRatio_s = sign(r15m)*ln(volRatio), ATRrank_s = (rank-0.5)*sign(r1h)); the probability models use them unsigned (ln(volRatio), rank-0.5). relBTC features are identically 0 for BTC.
features.returns: log returns of primary 15m closes (15m aggregated from complete 1m bars)
features.vwap: typical-price VWAP of primary 1m bars from 00:00 Toronto of the block's date through block end
features.normalization: per-asset median and 1.4826*MAD fitted only on the training window; z winsorized at +/-3; MAD==0 -> z=0

uphill.trend_filter: long requires dEMA50_1h >= 0 (1h trend not down); short requires dEMA50_1h <= 0

persistence.sigma: sigma_h = std of 15m log returns over trailing 672 blocks (strictly before t) * sqrt(h)
persistence.agreement: a_h = 1 if sign(r_h) == sign(dEMA50_1h) == sign(dVWAP), else 0
persistence.use: context only (spec: not an entry gate until 100 resolved obs per bucket over 30 dates)

15m.definition: r = ln(close of next 15m block / close of cutoff block), primary provider. UP if r > +band, DOWN if r < -band, else RANGE.
15m.band_rationale: Cost-based: RANGE = a 15m move too small to pay a Jupiter 2x round trip. From the most recent stored real quote before freezing (QT-DC-20261010-1045-BTC-A-long-1: roundTripEstimateUsd 0.074408 on 49.89 notional = 0.149%) plus v3.1.1 modeled adverse slippage 5 bps per side (0.10%) = 0.249%, rounded to 0.25%.

session_close.definition: r = close of the 11:00 Toronto 1h bar (= close of 11:59 1m) on the next session date whose 12:00 close is after the cutoff / close of the last completed 1h bar at or before the cutoff - 1. UP if r > +0.5%, DOWN if r < -0.5%, else RANGE (same 0.5% threshold as the v3.1.1 forecast definition).
session_close.model: conditional frequency on sign of trailing 4h return (time-series momentum, 2 buckets), Laplace alpha=1, rolling 365 prior samples taken at the same Toronto clock hour; reported only, not used for the action

probability.main_model: multinomial logistic regression, L2 ridge, on the 9-feature z vector plus per-asset intercepts, pooled BTC/ETH/SOL

sub_models_for_disagreement.baseline: per-asset Laplace(1) class frequency in the training window

probability.disagreement: D = mean over classes of the variance across the 4 sub-model probability vectors
probability.walk_forward: expanding window; test folds = the 10 consecutive 24h blocks ending at the cutoff; each fold trains (normalization, models) only on samples whose label resolved <= fold start - embargo
probability.calibration: temperature scaling; fold j uses a temperature fitted on out-of-fold predictions of folds < j (T=1 if fewer than 2); the live forecast uses T fitted on all out-of-fold predictions
probability.margin_threshold: theta_M = 0.75 quantile of out-of-fold calibrated margins
probability.prob_lcb_rule: for the class backing the action (UP for LONG, DOWN for SHORT): Wilson 95% lower bound of the realized hit rate among out-of-fold calibrated predictions for that asset whose p_k is within +/-0.05 of the current p_k (min 30 obs) must exceed the asset's training base rate of that class

conformal.method: split conformal on out-of-fold calibrated class scores s = 1 - p(true class), most recent 7 folds (time-ordered, all strictly before the cutoff)
conformal.coverage_check: rolling: fold j's sets use the quantile from folds < j (j>=3); if observed coverage is below 1-alpha beyond its 95% binomial (Wilson) interval, conformal action permission is disabled

ev.return_bins: UP/RANGE/DOWN classes with per-asset conditional mean and SE of the 15m log return in each class over the training window, scaled by current ATR% / median training ATR%
ev.se_rule: SE^2 = sum_k p_k^2 SE(m_k)^2 + (sum_k p_k m_k^2 - (sum_k p_k m_k)^2) / n_eff
ev.quote_fallback: if a live read-only quote fails, use the most recent stored real quote for that asset/side from captain.db quotes (read-only), label STALE, scale fee components to the live notional; never invent a cost

joint_state.covariance: 15m log returns over the 672 blocks strictly before the cutoff; constant-correlation shrinkage delta=0.3; if any asset ATRrank > 0.8 correlations are stressed halfway toward 1
joint_state.gamma_note: costs are already inside mu (net LCB per leg), so no extra turnover penalty
joint_state.tail_loss: normal ES95 of the stressed portfolio 15m return = 2.0627 * sigma_p

opportunity.calibration_quality: clip(1 - ECE/0.10, 0, 1), ECE of out-of-fold calibrated top-class probability for that asset, 10 equal-width bins
opportunity.data_quality: 1.0 all checks pass and live quote; 0.5 stale stored quote; 0 any data check fails

switching.research_book_start: FLAT (research book is separate from Captain v3 official trades and from Crypto Captain's paper ledger)
switching.rule: switch only if LCB(EV(a*)) - LCB(EV(current)) > C_switch_incremental + H_t
switching.c_switch_note: LCB(EV) is already net of round-trip stressed costs, so from FLAT the incremental switch cost is 0; switch_cost_usd reports the full round-trip cost for transparency

risk.session_window: v3.1.1 decision window 06:00-11:45 Toronto; outside it the research action is WAIT

diagnostics.n_eff: n / (1 + 2 sum_{k=1}^{K} rho_k) on time-ordered out-of-fold Brier errors per asset; K = first lag with rho_k <= 0 (max 96). Stability: fixed K in {16,48,96}; max/min > 1.5 -> INCONCLUSIVE
diagnostics.null_test: fixed-margin permutation of predicted labels (holds row and column totals), statistic = accuracy, 2000 samples, seed 20261010
